decision.selected_r580_behavior: keep the ordinary NV04_CONTROL exception-mask bridge in the default R580 patch series
decision.experimental_alternative: retain the fail-closed guard only as an isolated compiled experiment
decision.rationale: The source-only null-object composition does not establish runtime failure. A prior R580 V100 capture reports RM status 0 for public command 0x83DE0309, but does not resolve the target class. A separate R595 RTX 5080 capture resolves GT200_DEBUGGER and reports status 0. The guarded route would deliberately replace the RM result with NV_ERR_NOT_SUPPORTED, so it is not selected without a discriminating Volta observation.

r580_v100.interpretation: successful public control was observed, but the target class is unresolved

r595_blackwell.interpretation: stock Blackwell control path succeeds; does not validate the hybrid provider or identify the Volta route

implementation.experimental_guard_effect: returns NV_OK transport with control_status=NV_ERR_NOT_SUPPORTED and does not issue NV04_CONTROL

next_discriminating_experiment.action: On an explicitly available PC3 window with an authorized V100 guest route, repeat stock R580 context capture and resolve public 0x83DE0309 to the same-root allocation class using redacted class, owner, and RM status only.
next_discriminating_experiment.decision_rule: If it is GT200_DEBUGGER and succeeds, retain the normal route and investigate the R580 runtime dispatch. If it is another class, inspect only that class/control relation. If the normal hybrid provider then fails on a permitted canary, compare an isolated guarded build only after proving the specific context impact.
next_discriminating_experiment.safety: stock reference first; no experimental module installation or loading in this step
